shellCommands.command: echo "=== 1. Home (empty) ===" && curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -oE 'Nothing in progress yet\.|No finished books yet\.' && echo "=== 2. Add book 1 (reading) ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST localhost:3000/books -d "title=The Pragmatic Programmer&author=Hunt&notes=Great chapters on debugging." && echo "=== 3. Add book 2 (reading) ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST localhost:3000/books -d "title=Refactoring&author=Fowler&notes=" && echo "=== 4. books.json ===" && cat books.json && echo "=== 5. Home shows 2 reading ===" && curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -c '<article class=\"book\">'

echo "=== After restart, home still shows both books ===" && curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -oE 'The Pragmatic Programmer|Refactoring|Finished|Mark as finished' | sort | uniq -c && echo "=== Detail page still works post-restart ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "localhost:3000/books/$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('books.json'))[0].id)")"

sleep 1 && echo "=== After restart, home still shows both books ===" && curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -oE 'The Pragmatic Programmer|Refactoring|Finished|Mark as finished' | sort | uniq -c && echo "=== Detail page still works post-restart ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "localhost:3000/books/$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('books.json'))[0].id)")"
